clusters.headline: Indonesian House Advances Impeachment Inquiry Into Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: A coalition of 120 members from eight parliamentary factions has formally submitted a petition for an opinion-stating right.
The legislative proposal specifically concerns the potential impeachment of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Reportedly Resigns
aiSummaryBullets: Reports indicate that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has submitted his resignation to President Prabowo Subianto.
Budi Arie Setiadi, the chairman of Projo, confirmed the resignation, though the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) reported awaiting further information.

clusters.headline: Officials Refute Presidential Advice Regarding Gibran Diploma Case
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials stated there is no further legal recourse available for Vice President Gibran to challenge his invalid high school diploma.
The Communications Agency denied reports suggesting the President advised the Vice President to continue the legal battle at the Administrative Court.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Parliament Moves To Initiate Impeachment Of Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 120 members of the House of Representatives from eight political factions have submitted a formal motion to initiate impeachment proceedings.
The legislative proposal concerning the Vice President's eligibility is scheduled to be reviewed in an upcoming plenary session of the House.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Police Deny Rumors Regarding Arrest Of Former KPK Chief
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Metropolitan Police clarified that former KPK chairman Firli Bahuri was not arrested while at a badminton court.
Law enforcement officials visited the former official to facilitate ongoing legal proceedings regarding his status as a suspect.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Inaugurates Facilities In Nagan Raya
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated the Baitul 'Ala Jade Mosque and the Rakyat School located in Nagan Raya, Aceh.
The President was accompanied by Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian, who also oversaw disaster recovery aid distribution in the region.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Visits Aceh For Flag Event And Mosque Inauguration
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially inaugurated the Jade Mosque located in Aceh.
The visit included an event where residents unfurled a 24-kilometer national flag to establish a new record.

clusters.headline: Landslides Impact Multiple Residential Areas Across South Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: Multiple landslides occurred in South Jakarta, affecting residential areas in Kemang, Pasar Minggu, and Pejaten Timur.
The collapse at a padel court parking project in Kemang damaged five homes, leading residents to question the site's permits and construction procedures.

clusters.headline: KPK Questioned Hercules Over Summarecon Corruption Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Hercules Rosario Marshal was interrogated by the KPK for several hours regarding a corruption investigation at the Ministry of ATR/BPN.
The inquiry centered on a payment of 800 million rupiah received from Summarecon in relation to the company's land rights permit case.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Attends NasDem Party 15th Anniversary Event
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto attended the 15th anniversary event of the NasDem Party in Jakarta.
The event was hosted by NasDem Party chairman Surya Paloh and attended by various political figures.
